name: smart_ui_scan
description:
Scans the current screen using local computer vision and perceptual hashing.
Returns a compact JSON scene graph (<60 tokens) with active focus, open windows, and interactive elements.
Prevents raw images from polluting the LLM context.

source.description: Capture source: 'desktop' (Windows PC screen, active windows, desktop buttons) or 'bluestacks' (BlueStacks / Android emulator)
